task_a_protocol_inspection.protocol_wording: LCB_95(P_hat_joint) >= 0.90 where LCB_95 is the exact Clopper-Pearson 95% lower confidence bound

detected_ambiguity.text_specification: Explicitly names a '95% lower confidence bound' (statistically implying tail alpha = 0.05).
detected_ambiguity.code_implementation: scripts/stage6m_v1_5_sample_size_power_sweep.py called clopper_pearson_interval(..., alpha=0.05), extracting the lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% CI (tail alpha/2 = 0.025, which is mathematically a 97.5% one-sided LCB).
detected_ambiguity.historical_reports: Task 5 reports (stage6m_v1_5_sample_size_power_sweep.md) and Task 6 reports (stage6m_v1_5_scientific_readiness_audit.md) quoted the two-sided interval lower endpoint as the LCB.

task_a_protocol_inspection.root_cause: Nomenclature conflation between a one-sided (1 - alpha) lower confidence bound and the lower endpoint of a two-sided (1 - alpha) confidence interval.

unrounded_comparison.explanation: The difference of 0.095138 pp between the two bounds arises entirely from the tail probability: Beta(0.05; 9058, 943) = 90.085739% vs Beta(0.025; 9058, 943) = 89.990601%. At 10,000 trials, the two-sided lower endpoint requires k >= 9059 (short by 1 trajectory), whereas the one-sided LCB requires k >= 9050 (cleared by 8 trajectories).

under_two_sided_interpretation.criterion: Lower Endpoint of Two-Sided 95% Clopper-Pearson CI >= 90.00%
under_two_sided_interpretation.verdict: SHORTFALL (-0.0094 pp shortfall; 1 trial out of 10,000)

task_c_acceptance_decision.principled_recommendation: Recommend that the Project Lead formally adopt Option 1 (One-Sided 95% LCB) prior to Cohort 3 authorization. In statistical methodology and regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA), validation that power or efficacy exceeds a minimum required threshold is universally formulated as a one-sided hypothesis test (H1: Power >= 0.90 at alpha = 0.05). Requiring the two-sided lower endpoint inadvertently imposes an unstated 97.5% confidence standard (alpha = 0.025). Until formal Project-Lead sign-off is executed, CONDITIONAL HOLD must be strictly preserved.

benchmark_candidate.status: SUPPLEMENTAL BENCHMARK ONLY (Requires 10k confirmation if elevated to primary)

superseded_results.supersession_reason: The Task 5 95.35% power estimate was obtained under an uncalibrated generator where probability clipping produced an unintended -2.1733 pp disparity narrowing (a 0.1733 pp overshoot). The corrected 90.58% result reflects the genuine -2.0000 pp registered disparity target.

task_d_sample_size_reconciliation.scientific_limitation: All simulated power estimates are conditional on the assumed -2.0 pp disparity narrowing. Under weaker disparity effects (-1.5 pp or -1.0 pp), power degrades to 77.5% and 41.7% respectively. These assumptions must be documented in the dissertation as design scenarios rather than physical guarantees.
